• ILUVIEN: ▪ ILUVIEN ® net revenues were $18.7 million for the second quarter of 2026, a decrease of 16.1% over the same period in 2025 based primarily on timing of international shipments. ▪ The Company announced 6-month topline data from the Phase 4 open-label single-arm SYNCHRONICITY clinical trial in chronic non-infectious uveitis affecting the posterior segment of the eye (NIU-PS) and anticipates announcing the detailed results and additional analyses at a key medical conference attended by retina specialists in the fourth quarter of 2026.
